name: quorum-submit-atomic-metadata-closeout
title: Make quorum_submit close host-verdict metadata atomically
description: A clean REVIEW worktree becomes dirty after quorum_submit appends six host_verdict rows without committing them. Subsequent long validation can execute every command and then fail canonical persistence. Add a committed RED production-path harness, then atomically close only the quorum-owned verdict delta with complete rollback and fail-closed behavior.
